description: This file defines the LikeOperator class, which implements a string filter operator ('LIKE') used within the SuiteCRM JSON API filter framework. The class provides methods to return the filter tag and SQL operator, and validates the operator input.

classes.name: LikeOperator
classes.description: Implements a 'LIKE' string filter operator for JSON API filters, enabling pattern matching in queries.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag representing this operator, 'li'.

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL string representation of the operator, 'LIKE'.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that the input operator is a string and delegates further validation to its parent implementation.
